name: Lemon-Curry Lentil Salad with Crunchy Cauliflower, Cucumber & Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, cumin, and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups brown lentils, dried
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 lemons
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
6 sticks celery
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro
3 (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Remove leaves and thick stems from each cauliflower, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp turmeric, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place cauliflower in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender and golden, about 20 minutes.
While the cauliflower is roasting, peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Zest and juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp curry powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and celery; cut both crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the cauliflower is done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.
When the lentils are done, drain in a colander, rinse with cold water, and add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies.
Add roasted cauliflower to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide arugula and lentil salad between plates. Top with pine nuts and enjoy!
